owner_policy: Course selection stages a validated File without changing active lesson state until explicit Start.
Start invokes resetSession(nextDeck), clears first answers/practice, and renders the first new question.
Reset keeps the selected deck; reload returns to the bundled source.
Cancel, malformed or unreadable input, and superseded reads preserve current session.
Imported lesson uses its own concepts and attribution; imported Apply-it prompt is generic.
Trace archive checks full selected course identity and model, preserves current-tab reflections, and invalidates preview when active lesson stamp changes.
independent_receiving_scope: Six historical trace assertions remain exact; five native course sequences additionally qualify notes, canonical answer identity, imported prompt, reset and course isolation. No picker/validator/trace/author implementation edits.
